edges.reason: from parameter flows into _transfer logic.
to parameter flows into _transfer logic.
amount parameter flows into _transfer logic and fee math.
tokenAmount parameter flows into swapTokensForEth swap call.
tokenAmount parameter flows into addLiquidity router call.
_token parameter flows into balanceOf and transfer call.
_to parameter flows into transfer recipient.
_marketingAddress parameter writes to marketingAddress state.
contractBalance local drives swap amount in swapBack.
ethForMarketing local drives ETH split in swapBack.
msg.sender is the recipient of the ETH forwarded by withdrawStuckETH.
msg.sender is used as the source of airdrop transfers.
block.timestamp is passed as swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as liquidity deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
swapBack performs an external value call to marketingAddress after state changes.
withdrawStuckETH performs an external value call to msg.sender.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call that can transfer control.
_transfer writes _balances using unchecked arithmetic.
transferForeignToken performs an external ERC20 call to an arbitrary token.
marketingAddress is the target of the low-level value call.
tokensForLiquidity determines liquidityTokens split in swapBack and is reset there.
tokensForMarketing determines ETH split in swapBack and is reset there.
swapping flag guards entry into swapBack.
_transfer calls swapBack which executes external calls.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth.
swapBack calls addLiquidity.
botscantrade gates whether flagged bot wallets can transfer.
tradingActiveBlock is compared to block.number for sniper penalty.
swapTokensAtAmount is the threshold for triggering swapBack.
_isExcludedFromFees influences fee logic and swapBack invocation.
automatedMarketMakerPairs classify buys/sells in _transfer.
setMarketingAddress writes marketingAddress.
enableTrading sets tradingActiveBlock to current block.number.
airdropToWallets calls _transfer for each recipient.
onlyOwner check on _owner gates enableTrading.
onlyOwner check on _owner gates setMarketingAddress.
onlyOwner check on _owner gates withdrawStuckETH.
onlyOwner check on _owner gates transferForeignToken.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the swap call.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
